A1.claim: Check: the control repeats P2.7's committed eq value, gain and exploitability of BR, RNR .5/.9 and DBR at every size

A2.claim: Check: the comparison covers all 150 control bots

A3.claim: Check: the control's KL to the family is at most 1e-6

A4.claim: Check: the equilibrium hero never has negative value against any bot

A5.claim: Check: with 3,000 hands BR captures at least 97% of the control's oracle gain

B1.claim: Every rule kind's KL-implied hands to 20:1 (an optimistic bound) are at most 150

C1.claim: With 3,000 hands BR captures between 60% and 90% against each off-family kind

C2.claim: slight_street's BR capture at 3,000 hands is between 92% and 99%

C3.claim: BR's gain over equilibrium at 3,000 hands has an interval above .1 for each off-family kind

C4.claim: BR does worse than equilibrium on at most 20% of bots of each off-family kind at 3,000

C5a.claim: Against the exact equilibrium BR's gain interval at 3,000 hands lies below -.01

C5b.claim: Against the exact equilibrium BR does worse than equilibrium on at least 95% of bots

C6.claim: The rank correlation of KL with BR's shortfall at 3,000 hands is between .2 and .55

C7.claim: RNR .9 keeps at least 87% of BR's gain at 3,000 hands against each off-family kind

C8.claim: RNR .9's exploitability at 3,000 hands is at most 62% of BR's against every kind

C9.claim: DBR gains at least .03 less than BR at 3,000 hands against each off-family kind

C10.claim: Against near_eq and board_blind the population model beats BR fitted on 10 hands

C11.claim: The five-parameter model beats the card-blind one at 3,000 hands for each off-family kind

D1.claim: Refit BR keeps at least 85% of the clairvoyant's gain against adapters inside the family

D2.claim: Refit BR's gain over fit-once BR has an interval above 0 against all four adapters

D3.claim: Against free adapters refit BR and RNR .9 lose to equilibrium in the second half

D4.claim: Against the fast free adapter refit BR, RNR .9 and recent-window BR do worse than equilibrium on at least 90% of bots

D5.claim: Against free adapters RNR .9 does not protect: its gain over BR has an upper bound of at most .02

D6.claim: Against the fast free adapter refit RNR .5's gain interval lies within .02 of 0

D7.claim: The clairvoyant gains at least .7 against free adapters

D8.claim: Equilibrium's value against free adapters is at most half its value against fixed bots

D9.claim: Against the slow free adapter the 300-hand window beats refit on all hands
